why: A second fix-round amendment to the typecheck port's plan, in today's tooling (docs/plan/quests/port-typecheck-PLAN.md, section 'Amendment, 2026-11-16 (fix round 2)'). Law L3 put the four scripts/typecheck* globs in the anti-slop-effect/no-manual-tag-comparison block, but the zero lock in oxlint-plugins/anti-slop.ts refuses a listed glob outside its scope, so lint printed four 'not a folder of its scope' lines. A read-only count of all ten taken anti-slop rules over scripts/ at 0df871b21 found 207 hits; no-manual-tag-comparison fires on 7 of the 8 product lines the first fix round named (LocksFile.ts:19 compares _tag with a parameter, not a literal, and is no hit) and on 3 unplanned lines in scripts/effect-arbitrary.test.ts (72, 90, 132). So scripts/** cannot be green in this quest, and the scope gains only the port's four globs, in folders() and in the lock run's ROOTS. The lock then asks for 28 new zero-hit entries in other taken rules' blocks. New laws: L8 (test, anti-slop.test.ts: the scope holds the four globs and no taken rule's block names a refused glob) and L9 (lint: the zero lock prints no line for them). All of it is the tests step's, since oxlint-plugins/ and .oxlintrc.json are exam paths. The first fix round's Mercurial cite '_trylock (lines 297-343)' is corrected to 298-343.
note: The count ran from a script in the scratchpad on a scratch oxlint config outside the repo, built as anti-slop.ts's count() builds its own; nothing in the repo changed for it. plancheck --draft passed on an unsigned copy in the scratchpad, plan-sha256 a58db1a88a8c54f04c5f27e0a82a225934e0fc1656515ce5787496fb555ef1da; the signed first line was left for the lead to sign again. pnpm lint at 0df871b21 fails in node oxlint-plugins/lint.ts on the 7 product tag-comparison lines and the 4 refused lines, none from this change; lint:promise-types died with EPIPE when the box ran out of memory and passed when run alone (0 findings). No test or pnpm typecheck ran.
